terra.problem: Aaron's relationship to Moses and his role as high priest are facts from outside the passage and need references.
Joshua's role as Moses' helper and his later leadership are facts from outside the passage and need references.
The oven-timer comparison does not match the situation. A timer sounding and nobody opening the oven does not illustrate a father's silence allowing a vow to stand.
The claim that offerings appear throughout Numbers refers to material outside this passage and needs a reference.
